verification_scope: Structural inventory crosschecked against both sources; all GFG descriptive pages visually inspected, GateForum descriptive OCR and targeted visual checks. Objective page anchors from extracted text and boundary renders, not full option-by-option fidelity certification. No official key located/claimed.

discrepancies.question: A group2
discrepancies.note: GFGp3 explicitly says one or more correct, write ALL correct options, credit only if all and only correct options given. GateForump5 wrongly/inconsistently says ONLY ONE. Preserve GFG legacy multiple-selection format for2.1–2.25.

discrepancies.question: B3(a)
discrepancies.note: GFG51(1)p6 includes Briefly point out the flaw in Mr.Xs proof; GateForum3(a)p9–10 omits this instruction after quoting the false proof. GF labels a/b, GFG labels1/2.

discrepancies.question: B6(b)
discrepancies.note: GateForump10 prints subset-or-equal symbol while explicitly saying strict subset. GFG54p6 also explicitly says strict subset. Preserve strict interpretation and disclose symbol ambiguity.

discrepancies.question: B9
discrepancies.note: GateForump11 grammar has malformed/slashed production separators and missing radix point. GFG57p7 is better but low resolution. Visually check S→L.L|L, L→LB|B, B→0|1 against raster before authoring; example101.101=5.625 clarifies fractional intention. Not a verified original correction.

discrepancies.question: B11(a)
discrepancies.note: GateForump11 loses asymptotic O glyphs, prints empty parentheses. GFG59p7 visibly states O(1), O(1/n), and asks O-notation. Preserve upper-bound versus exact-time qualification in solution.

discrepancies.question: B15
discrepancies.note: GateForump12 omits initial a=2 and assignment glyphs; GFG63p8 clearly a:=2,b:=3. Three passing modes share5marks; no individual mode allocation printed.

discrepancies.question: B18
discrepancies.note: GateForump14 omits8 from prose each bit wide; GFG66p8 says each8bit wide, consistent with2K×8 heading.

discrepancies.question: B19
discrepancies.note: GFG67p8 renders216 without visible superscript; GateForump14 has2^16. Use visual GateForum address-space exponent, not OCR216.

discrepancies.question: marks
discrepancies.note: GFG has descriptive subpart marks, GF omits them. Q5a(i)/(ii) share1mark; Q15i/ii/iii share5marks. Do not assign unsupported individual marks. All descriptive offered groups carry5marks.
